stage2_messages.content: Generate a minimal source-code access-control patch. Reuse project guard semantics exactly. Unauthorized requests must be blocked before sensitive operations. Do not refactor unrelated code. Return only JSON, no Markdown.

stage2_patch.explanation: Added a top-level authentication guard immediately after the opening PHP tag. The guard reuses the application's existing session login sentinel $_SESSION["login"] and the project's standard denial style header("Location: login.php"); exit;. Because the file reads $_SESSION, a compatible session initialization check is added before the guard so the session is available. Unauthenticated direct requests to backdoor.php now redirect to login.php and exit before either the uploader form or upload handling can run, while authenticated sessions continue to access the intended admin/uploader logic. The existing inner upload-branch guard is preserved.
